snippet.title: Kyubu Kyubu Dice - Teaser 2025
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2120220/Kyubu_Kyubu_Dice/

Kyubu Kyubu Dice is an action puzzle game where you roll a magical die to match and clear colorful panels. Easy to pick up, but challenging to master! It's a fun and addictive puzzle experience!
